description: This PHP source file defines the BucketEndpointArnMiddleware class, which is an internal middleware component in the AWS SDK for PHP that handles the detection and processing of ARN (Amazon Resource Name) identifiers in S3 bucket-related commands, modifying endpoints accordingly.
